# Real names the profanity filter must let through: people, places and
# grounds from every region the game covers. Test data only, read by
# test/unit/profanity/profanity_filter_test.dart. One name per line; a
# line starting with # is a comment.
#
# Part 1 is hand-picked: real players, coaches, grounds and towns, heavy
# on the ones that hold a refused stem. Part 2 is the per-country first
# name, surname and place lists of the Faker library (MIT licence).
# Part 3 is the BSD /usr/share/dict/propernames list.
